Here's my attempt to remove the `render` function alltogether so we can use `getWidgetRenderState` everywhere https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4549/commits/74ab771d35aacf882ebe185defd960510419cd6e

The only thing that bother me is the need to pass a `isFromSearch` flag in `renderOptions` (an alternative way is to set it in the upper scope but I'm not sure it is better, thought ?)

(The tests pass with some small changes, hope I did not break anything, this file is kind of a mess and a rewrite wouldn't be too much)
